nodes.title: Does gpt-4.1-mini single on the OUTCOME-before-KIND contract match tiered again in a second round? Round 6 is the first round in which a mini-single contract matched tiered (42.0 vs 42 on TEST, no moment or objection loss); decision.2026-10-24.analysis-default-tiered reverses only after two consecutive rounds
nodes.closes_when: Round 7, on the contract as shipped: two TEST passes each of gpt-4.1-mini single and tiered. Mini within 1/42 of tiered on the mean with no moment or objection loss meets the reverse_if; otherwise tiered stands and the round-6 result is logged as variance.

nodes.title: In the r5-outcome-first arm the OUTCOME block moves before KIND, but a workspace's 'OUTCOME, client rule: ...' line stays after CODE, two blocks away from the outcome rules it qualifies; the no-question prompt's 'OUTCOME: always null.' also moves. The bench sets no client rule and always has a question, so neither is measured [inference: move the client rule with the OUTCOME block when the arm ships]
nodes.closes_when: The shipped contract keeps the client-rule line inside the OUTCOME block, and a bench run with a judge_version client rule (or a test that pins the line order) shows no outcome, objection or moment loss against round 6.
